lines: The Company is maintaining its underlying full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $212 million to $216 million, which excludes the $14.0 million one-time revenue item recognized in the third quarter and represents 13% year-over-year growth at the midpoint of the range.
Including the one-time revenue item, the Company’s full-year 2026 revenue guidance is $226 million to $230 million.

CAGR from 2019 to 2025 $212M to $216M FY2026 underlying revenue guidance, up 13% at the midpoint; $226M to $230M including one-time payment. $137.6M, no debt Cash and short-term investments as of 3Q FY26, with no debt 3
